channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh McRoberts | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh McRoberts from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Josh McRoberts, Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Rick Carlisle on injured Mavericks like Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith, Josh McRoberts:

“We’re still hoping to get some guys back at some point. We’re just not sure what month. I’ve been wrong so far. Not December.”

Rick Carlisle on Josh McRoberts, Seth Curry, Dorian Finney-Smith, Dec 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
Toward the close of the email, Arison wrote:

“What won't change is the culture of this organization. The Miami HEAT is a Championship organization. I fully expect this team, from Pat Riley to Head Coach Erik Spoelstra, to our veterans Chris Bosh, Udonis Haslem, Goran Dragic and Josh McRoberts, to our returning young core of Hassan Whiteside, Justise Winslow, Josh Richardson and Tyler Johnson, to the fresh faces joining the HEAT Family to continue our mantra of being the 'hardest working, best conditioned, most professional, unselfish, toughest, meanest, nastiest team in the NBA.'”

Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Aug 12, 2016. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Josh McRoberts
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Spo on McRoberts' bone bruise:

“Guys that are tough want to play through it. Sometimes it gets better. It wasn't getting better with Josh.”

Erik Spoelstra on Josh McRoberts, Dec 21, 2015. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Josh McRoberts
item.description:
Surya Fernandez:Spoelstra on McRoberts injury:

“It’s tough. You feel for him more than anything else because you wanted him to come in here and contribute.”

Erik Spoelstra on Josh McRoberts, Dec 15, 2014. Source: Twitter @SuryaHeatNBA.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Josh McRoberts
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Jordan on losing Josh McRoberts:

“I told to Josh myself about how much he meant to the team and how we wanted him back.”

Michael Jordan on Josh McRoberts, Oct 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Mike Conley on Steve Clifford, Josh McRoberts
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Agent Mike Conley on Josh McRoberts' decision:

“He just labored over it because he so loves (Hornets coach Steve) Clifford.”

Mike Conley on Steve Clifford, Josh McRoberts, Jul 7, 2014. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Rich Cho on Josh McRoberts
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Hornets GM Rich Cho:

“Josh (McRoberts) is a big part of our team. We definitely want to re-sign him.”

Rich Cho on Josh McRoberts, Jun 18, 2014. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Josh McRoberts
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Jordan on McRoberts:

“Hopefully he doesn't opt out of his contract. We need to do everything we can to keep him.”

Michael Jordan on Josh McRoberts, Nov 1, 2013. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.
